purpose: Promote already-current faction procedures into packages/game-data/current-game.json so the Comprehensive Rules can remain a direct authority projection.

military: Command lifecycle and first-win trigger edge cases
diplomats: optional imposition after refused Terms and a win
financiers: Capital and immediately recalculating Capital Limit
intelligence: Intel and Operation Progress, including start-of-turn Intel equal to Operation Progress
Mission slot and hidden Active Mission state
Interference, optional removal, replacement, choice revision, and Direct Interference

source_status: The normalized procedures already exist in current reviewed player-facing faction material and/or current structured authority. This change makes those mechanics explicit in the sole canonical authority; it does not intentionally alter gameplay.

authority_layout.canonical_procedures: Exact faction procedures live once in packages/game-data/current-game.json under gameplay.faction_rules or the dedicated Proposal/Mystics corpora.
authority_layout.faction_feature_metadata: factionFeatures remains taxonomy/profile metadata and does not duplicate exact procedure text.
authority_layout.registry: Each faction.<id>.features registry entry fingerprints both factionFeatures.<id> metadata and gameplay.faction_rules.<id> procedures; dedicated Proposal and Mystics Rite dependencies remain separate.

migration: One-time normalization and finalization scripts/workflows were used only to materialize the canonical branch state and were removed before merge.
validation: scripts/validate-faction-rules-authority.mjs asserts required procedures, single-source layout, registry dependencies, and key invariants across all six factions.
Rules publication authority CI runs the permanent faction authority validator.
The canonical result is packages/game-data/current-game.json plus its rules-surface registry dependencies; no migration script is required after merge.
